Full skill text at 5★
Restores (600% of Heavy-armored Rhinoceros' ATK + 60000) HP to all allies. If the target's HP is already full, grants a [Shield] equal to (600% of Heavy-armored Rhinoceros' ATK + 60000) instead. Afterward, grants [Scale Armor Ward] to all allies for 2 turns. [Scale Armor Ward]: Reduces DMG taken by 50%, blocks the next 2 control effects, and increases DMG dealt by 50% when at full HP. Meanwhile, reduces all enemies' Skill DMG dealt by 20% and ATK by 20% for 2 turns, while increasing all allies' Skill DMG dealt and ATK by the same amount for 2 turns. When an ally inflicts a control effect, Heavy-armored Rhinoceros gains 10% Energy and 1 layer of [Regenerative Scale Mark]. [Regenerative Scale Mark]: When an ally's DMG taken in total exceeds 40% of their Max HP, consumes 1 layer to restore (600% of Heavy-armored Rhinoceros's ATK + 60000) HP to the ally. Before Heavy-armored Rhinoceros proactively casts a skill, it additionally gains 5 layers of [Regenerative Scale Mark]. Before Heavy-armored Rhinoceros proactively casts a skill, removes all debuffs from all allies, cleanses 1 layer of buffs from each enemy, with a 20% chance to inflict Stun on them for 1 turn. If there are 5 allies with the [Poison] tag in the team, before each proactive skill cast, additionally increases all allies' Mastery by 5% and DoT dealt by 5%; this effect is stackable up to 5 layers. At the beginning of a battle, for every 1 ally with the [Control] tag deployed, Heavy-armored Rhinoceros gains 20% Energy and increases all allies' Effect Hit by 10%. Additionally reduces all enemies' Healed Effect by 100%, and the Healed Effect Reduction effect is reduced by 20% each turn. While allies with the [Control] tag have [Scale Armor Ward], 50% of the DMG they take is delayed and settled evenly at the start of the next 2 turns, and the delayed DMG is reduced by 50%. Besides, for every 20% Max HP worth of cumulative DMG taken, the ally gains a [Shield] equal to (600% of Heavy-armored Rhinoceros' ATK + 120000); this effect can trigger up to 2 times. Before Heavy-armored Rhinoceros proactively casts a skill, inflicts [Cracked Armor Deterrence] on all enemies for 2 turns. [Cracked Armor Deterrence]: Reduces Turn Meter by 20% when inflicted with control effects; this effect can trigger up to 2 times and resets trigger count when inflicted again. If the target is a Boss, additionally increases their DoT taken by 100% and Poison DMG taken by 100%, and inflicts [Cold II] on them for 2 turns.
Source: game files.
